verdict: NOT APPROVED. I read all 25 Hebrew line crops and s283.jpg; every block was checked. The English facing page (s283) matches its candidate exactly, punctuation included. The Hebrew consonants match, except that ח/ה is unresolved in הֶשְׁבּוֹנוֹת and חֵטְא. One patch: add the missing printed period to the rubric. Nine vowel/dagesh/letter questions are still open; the strongest is the bar under kaf of שִׁכֵּן. I found no misapplied human decisions. The ומצות dispute is on scan 292 and outside this pair, so it isn't settled here. A safety-classifier interruption cut off my visible notes for lines 12–17 partway through; I recorded those findings again above from the images I had viewed.
